title: Alchemist
primary_theme: Accelerator-led founder development for enterprise startups
founder_lessons: A strong accelerator is as much about community and mentorship as it is about funding.
Technical founders benefit when they can signal quality through customer development and cohort outcomes.
Founders should expect to drive their own momentum while using the accelerator network to unlock customers and investors.
Good accelerators reduce loneliness and provide a structured path through the early stage journey.
notable_quotes: We're asking questions to, first of all, tease out why they're starting the company and why they think now is the right time for this to become a phenomenon.
Most of our founders... love Alchemist for is the community. ... being a part of a cohort is psychologically, incredibly comforting.
We have this whole system called the vault, which has over 20,000 people in it. That's the online network that our founders use to book office hours with mentors.
